model_meta.description: Conceptual model of the disclosed harmonic drive and its flexible transmission and connecting-element arrangement.

subsystems.description: Wave generator assembly; in the described embodiment it includes a rolling bearing with a noncircular inner ring and rolling elements, which enforce a noncircular shape on the flexible element.
Flexible element having radially nested, axially overlapping spline and running tooth systems joined by a ring section; the running-tooth region adapts to the wave-generator contour.
Rigid housing-side connecting element; the described example is a chain sprocket and its toothing engages the flexible element spline teeth around the circumference.
Output-side connecting element having mating running teeth; it engages the flexible element running tooth system and may be slidably supported on the spline-tooth section.

Cover with inward radial tongues engaging recesses in the flexible element ring-section recesses; tongues provide axial contact/support and secure the flexible element, output-side connecting element, and wave generator axially in the described embodiment.

item_flows.name: Noncircular mechanical deformation
item_flows.notes: Wave generator imposes its noncircular contour on the flexible element's running-tooth region.

item_flows.name: Running tooth engagement
item_flows.notes: Flexible running tooth system partially engages the output-side mating running tooth system.

item_flows.name: Rotational torque
item_flows.notes: Spline coupling and running-tooth engagement transmit torque; the patent describes slight relative output rotation and reduction in the example embodiment.

item_flows.name: Axial cover retention contact
item_flows.notes: Front-cover tongues engage ring-section recesses and provide axial securing/support; claim 7.

item_flows.name: Output-element sliding support
item_flows.notes: The output-side connecting element's smooth cylindrical sliding-bearing surface contacts the inside of the flexible element's spline-toothing wall, providing sliding support.

item_flows.name: Wave-generator contour contact
item_flows.notes: Contact interaction through which the wave generator enforces its noncircular contour on the flexible element; the resulting deformation remains an internal transformation of the flexible element.

steps.description: The wave generator imposes its noncircular contour on the flexible transmission element's running-tooth region.
The running tooth region adapts to the wave-generator contour and partially engages the mating running tooth system on the other connecting element.
The spline tooth system couples circumferentially to one connecting element for conjoint rotation.
